subject: ela
intro: We adjust our language to the situation. Formal English (complete sentences, standard grammar, polite words) fits presentations, letters to adults, and school writing. Informal English (casual words, contractions, slang) fits talking with friends. Fourth graders choose the right register for the context and use complete sentences when appropriate.

items.prompt: You are giving a class presentation. Which is more appropriate: 'Hey everyone, check this out' or 'Good morning. Today I will share what I learned'?

steps: A presentation is a formal setting.
'Good morning. Today I will share...' is formal and complete.
solution.answer: 'Good morning. Today I will share what I learned.'

items.prompt: You are texting a friend about weekend plans. Which fits: 'wanna hang out Sat?' or 'I would like to request your company on Saturday'?

steps: Texting a friend is an informal setting.
'wanna hang out Sat?' is casual and fits.
So that fits the informal context.

items.prompt: In a letter to your principal, you should use ____ English.

steps: Writing to an authority is a formal context.

items.prompt: A class presentation calls for ____ English.
Talking with close friends can use ____ English.
